column2: LinuxCNC + Mesa 7i80HDT (Ethernet FPGA host) with 7i44 on P3 (HostMot2 sserial port 0 channels 0/1 to 7i84U-A/B) + 7i49 on P1 (X/Y/Z resolvers + AOUT0..3 servo/spindle commands); AOUT4/AOUT5 and P2 unused/spare; probe on 7i84U-B IN15

P1/P2/P3 connector text corrected 2026-08-13 to match confirmed readhmid (P1=7i49, P2=unused, P3=7i44). The underlying .xlsx workbook itself was NOT re-exported/re-generated -- only this text summary. Regenerate the workbook's own connector-map tab before treating it as authoritative again.
COMMISSIONING_PENDING and ACCEPTED_VERIFY require cabinet verification before wiring or energizing outputs. HOLD_CONFLICT requires resolution first.
Axis feedback is Tamagawa TS2014N resolver feedback through the 7i49 on P1, not quadrature encoder feedback.
The hardware E-stop chain removes hazardous power. 7i84U-A TB2 IN29 is the sole software monitor input; the OEM hardware chain remains authoritative.
7i49 AOUT order is X=AOUT0, Z=AOUT1, Y=AOUT2, FR-SX spindle velocity=AOUT3; AOUT4/AOUT5 spare. FR-SX orient is discrete ORCM1.

7i80HDT P1/P2/P3 map (P1=7i49, P2=unused, P3=7i44 -- confirmed 2026-08-13, see mesa/mesa_firmware_checklist.md); 7i44 smart-serial channel map; 7i49 resolver + analog map; 7i84U-A and 7i84U-B field I/O; probe on 7i84U-B IN15; HAL cross-reference; open items/conflicts.
